title: Value Trackers & GPU Buffer Recycling Architecture

For copy-ready programs use the guides and demos; for current callable signatures use the source-derived API. Performance figures here describe reported experiments, not guaranteed frame rates.

blocks.text: Original document: [docs/VALUE_TRACKERS_AND_GPU_BUFFER_RECYCLING.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/VALUE_TRACKERS_AND_GPU_BUFFER_RECYCLING.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.
Mathematical animations often require continuous updates driven by moving parameters (e.g. a slider controlling curve frequency, or a dynamic tangent line moving along a graph).
Naively creating new entity instances every frame (`new FunctionGraph2D(...)`) causes severe performance bottlenecks:

items: **Garbage Collection (GC) Stutter**: Rapid allocation and deallocation of thousands of JavaScript objects.
**VRAM Churn**: Repeated allocation of GPU vertex, index, and uniform buffers.
**Pipeline Stalls**: Repeated compilation of WebGPU pipelines and bind group creation.

blocks.text: Retiam solves this through a dual-mechanism pattern:

items: **[`ValueTracker`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/trackers/ValueTrackers.ts)**: Invisible scalar entities packing animated numbers into GPU transform registers (`t1`), seamlessly integrating with the animation engine.

**[`alwaysRedraw`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/trackers/alwaysRedraw.ts)**: High-performance function wrapper incorporating the **`recycleGPUResources`** buffer-stealing algorithm, preserving existing GPU buffers and compiled pipelines across functional rebuilds.

blocks.code:
flowchart TD V["ValueTracker
tracker.value"] --> A["scene.play
tracker.animateValue(10)"] A --> R["alwaysRedraw"] --> E["Construct replacement entity"] E --> REC["recycleGPUResources"] REC --> G["Geometry buffer reuse
Transfer VBO / IBO capacities"] REC --> P["Pipeline and bind group reuse
Avoid GPU recompilation"] G --> O["Redrawn entity"] P --> O

blocks.text: The `ValueTracker` entity is marked `VISIBILITY = false` so it never submits render packets to the GPU:

items: **Register Storage**: The numerical scalar is stored inside `this.transform.t1`.

**Timeline Integration**: Calling `tracker.animateValue(target, options)` creates a standard [`StateAnimation`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/StateAnimation.ts) interpolating `t1`:

blocks.code:
const frequency = new ValueTracker(1.0);
  await scene.play(frequency.animateValue(5.0, { duration: 2000, rate_func: Rate.easeInOut() }));

items: The user's factory function instantiates a fresh entity `newEnt`.
Before the previous instance `oldEnt` is destroyed, `recycleGPUResources(oldEnt, newEnt)` executes:
